mapper.select: SELECT m.id,b.name AS brand,m.name FROM price_model m JOIN price_brand b ON b.id=m.brand_id WHERE m.enabled AND b.enabled AND b.name=#{brand} AND m.name=#{model} ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 2
SELECT model_id FROM shop_model_capability WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} ORDER BY model_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM shop_model_capability WHERE shop_id=#{shopId}
SELECT count(*) FROM price_model m JOIN price_brand b ON b.id=m.brand_id WHERE m.id=#{modelId} AND m.enabled AND b.enabled
SELECT id,shop_id,version,district_id,address_snapshot,longitude,latitude,source,created_at FROM shop_map_location WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_map_location(shop_id,version,district_id,address_snapshot,longitude,latitude,coordinate_system,source,created_by) VALUES(#{shopId},(SELECT COALESCE(max(version),0)+1 FROM shop_map_location WHERE shop_id=#{shopId}),#{districtId},#{address},#{longitude},#{latitude},'GCJ-02',#{source},#{actorId})
mapper.sql: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT s.id,s.name,s.address,l.id AS location_id,l.longitude,l.latitude,l.source,c.id AS city_id, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_model_capability x WHERE x.shop_id=s.id) THEN 'CAPABILITY_INCOMPLETE' WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_model_capability x WHERE x.shop_id=s.id AND x.model_id=#{modelId}) THEN 'MODEL_NOT_MATCHED' WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN 'LOCATION_INCOMPLETE' WHEN s.address IS DISTINCT FROM l.address_snapshot THEN 'LOCATION_STALE' WHEN NOT COALESCE(d.enabled AND c.enabled AND p.enabled AND d.level=3 AND c.level=2 AND p.level=1 AND p.code='440000' AND p.name='广东省' AND d.code ~ '^44[0-9]{4}$',false) THEN 'OUTSIDE_GUANGDONG' ELSE 'ELIGIBLE' END AS status FROM repair_shop s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM shop_map_location WHERE shop_id=s.id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true LEFT JOIN region d ON d.id=l.district_id LEFT JOIN region c ON c.id=d.parent_id LEFT JOIN region p ON p.id=c.parent_id WHERE s.enabled AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_service_region ssr WHERE ssr.shop_id=s.id AND ssr.region_id=#{regionId}) )
mapper.select: SELECT id,name,address,status,location_id,longitude,latitude,source,city_id FROM candidates ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_recommendation_query(id,actor_id,work_order_id,idempotency_key,fingerprint,model_id,direction,strategy,status,expires_at) VALUES(#{id},#{actorId},#{caseId},#{key},#{fingerprint},#{modelId},'VEHICLE_TO_SHOP',32,'RUNNING',#{expires}) ON CONFLICT(actor_id,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id,actor_id,work_order_id,fingerprint,model_id,status,expires_at FROM map_recommendation_query WHERE actor_id=#{actorId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT location_id FROM map_recommendation_shop WHERE query_id=#{queryId} AND shop_id=#{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE map_recommendation_query SET attempted_calls=attempted_calls+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND attempted_calls<50
UPDATE map_recommendation_query SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
